title: Writing to a nil map
hints: The tests report a panic: "assignment to entry in nil map". A nil map can be read from, but never written to.
`var out map[string]int` declares a nil map. You need make(...) to get a writable one. Don't fix it with `out := a`, because maps are shared: that would change the caller's map.
out := make(map[string]int, len(a)+len(b)), then add every entry of a and of b into out with out[k] += v.
